DIAGNOSIS READY: Advanced gastric malignancy (stomach cancer).

The constellation of progressive weight loss, night sweats, abdominal pain, and specifically the presence of enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes (Virchow's node) is highly suggestive of metastatic gastric cancer. I have reached my limit of ten questions and must conclude; please proceed with an immediate endoscopy with biopsy and CT imaging for confirmation.
